itemListElement.name: Read AI Pricing in 2026: What US Teams Pay for Free, Pro, Enterprise and Enterprise+

mainEntity.name: How much does Read AI cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Pro costs $19.75 per user per month on monthly billing, or $15 billed yearly, so one user pays $180 a year instead of $237. Already on Zoom One Pro, Business or Business Plus? Read AI says Zoom Essential Apps include its premium features at no extra cost, so check that before paying.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with no credit card required, but Free is strictly single-user. Read AI's FAQ says free users cannot be part of a Workspace, so an admin cannot manage free teammates or share their reports centrally. Anyone who wants team controls needs a paid license per person, starting at $15 billed yearly.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI cost money for teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and Read AI does not allow mixed plans. Every license in a Workspace must be on the same plan, so 2 people needing playback means Enterprise for all 10, or $2,700 a year instead of $1,800 on Pro. There are no admin-only licenses either; the account owner needs a seat too.

mainEntity.name: What is Read AI Enterprise pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Enterprise costs $22.50 per user per month billed yearly or $29.75 monthly, with no seat minimum. Large buyers get volume discounts on annual licenses: 10% at 100+, 15% at 500+ and 20% at 1,000+, according to Read AI's pricing FAQ. Enterprise+ adds a 5-license minimum.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Otter Pro costs $8.33 a month billed yearly, compared with $15 for Read AI Pro. Otter Pro caps you at 1,200 minutes a month and 90 minutes per meeting, though, while Read AI Pro has unlimited transcripts up to 4 hours each. Heavy users may find Read AI cheaper per meeting.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI offer a discount for annual billing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 25% on every paid plan, but the commitment is real. Read AI's FAQ says it does not offer refunds: you can cancel any time before renewal and keep access until the period ends.
